plugins.name: attune-harness
plugins.description: Run Attune Harness task workflows from Claude Code: plan, build, evidence review, scoped repair, testing a change, and inspecting or resuming saved tasks. Also includes independent cross-review, roundtable and test-gap skills. Needs the attune-harness CLI from PyPI (uv tool install 'attune-harness[all]'); installing the plugin authorizes no paid calls.
